{{Short description|Basketball team in 2023–24}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2023–24 |team=Creighton Bluejays |sport=Basketball |image=Creighton Bluejays wordmark.svg |image_size=125 |conference=Big East Conference |short_conf=Big East |record=25–10 |conf_record=14–6 |APRank=13 |CoachRank=11 |head_coach=[[Greg McDermott]] |hc_year=14th |asst_coach1=[[Ryan Miller (basketball coach)|Ryan Miller]] |ac1_year=3rd |asst_coach2=Jalen Courtney-Williams |ac2_year=3rd |asst_coach3=[[Derek Kellogg]] |ac3_year=1st |asst_coach4= |stadium = [[CHI Health Center Omaha]] |champion = |tourney = [[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Sweet Sixteen }} {{2023–24 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2023–24 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team''' represented [[Creighton University]] in the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bluejays, coached by 14th-year head coach [[Greg McDermott]], played their home games at the [[CHI Health Center Omaha]] in [[Omaha, Nebraska]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. In the [[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]], the Bluejays won their first round matchup against [[Akron Zips men's basketball|Akron]] before following with another victory over [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]] in the round of 32. However, their season would end in the Sweet 16 to [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee]], a team led by National Player of the Year [[Dalton Knecht]]. The Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team drew an average home attendance of 17,269 in 16 games in 2023-24.{{Cite news |title=MEN’S BASKETBALL ATTENDANCE RECORDS THROUGH 2024-25 |url=http://fs.ncaa.org.s3.amazonaws.com/Docs/stats/m_basketball_RB/Attend.pdf}} ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Bluejays]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 24–13, 14–6 in Big East play to finish in third place. As the No. 3 seed in the [[2023 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2022–23 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]] before losing to [[2022–23 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 6 seed in the South Region, where they defeated [[2022–23 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|NC State]], [[2022–23 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|Baylor]], and [[2022–23 Princeton Tigers men's basketball team|Princeton]] to reach the Elite Eight for the first time since [[1941 NCAA basketball tournament|1941]]. There they lost to [[2022–23 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]].{{cite web |last1=Anderson |first1=Rob |title=Men's Basketball Ends Historic Season in Elite Eight Thriller |url=https://gocreighton.com/news/2023/3/26/mens-basketball-creighton-vs-san-diego-state-recap.aspx |website=Creighton University Athletics |date=March 26, 2023 |publisher=Creighton University |access-date=12 April 2023}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
